items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023

ctx.x: Bucky Pizzarelli said, especially with the drummer, he said once you’ve got the straight eighth note down you were in. I loved that.
Ah. Well there you go, yeah. But you know Bucky, did he know, could he play “Dawn Go Away” by the Four Seasons by ear? I don’t think so. He wouldn’t want to. I think that’s more my —
But he learned to and he and his cohorts.
